exceptions.reason: Dense vertical navigation intentionally uses 44px targets and 2px separators. The companion interaction check verifies target size; workflow action groups still require 8px.

exceptions.selector: #vaults-panel .section-heading h2, #clients-panel .section-heading h2, #documents-panel .section-heading h2, #media-panel > h2, #models-panel > h2, #backend-panel > h2, #backups-panel > h2
exceptions.reason: These duplicate section names are deliberately 1px visually hidden headings for assistive technology. The companion check verifies their clipping contract and visible page heading.
axe 4.14 returns unresolved for a closed native dialog reference. The companion check verifies the real dialog target, expanded state, modal focus, Escape, and focus return.
axe 4.14 returns unresolved for the existing hidden listbox. Every reference and listbox role is checked separately; keyboard opening, Escape, value preservation and focus return are exercised.
axe cannot resolve the background of SVG text. The companion check computes foreground/background contrast for the rendered chart labels and requires 4.5:1.
Section captions can be partly outside the bounded navigation scrollport. The companion check verifies their real foreground/sidebar-background contrast.

Navigation rows can be partly outside the bounded scrollport after visiting lower pages; axe cannot resolve an occluded background. The companion check verifies actual text/background contrast for every navigation label, including selected and unselected rows.

Icon-rail navigation deliberately clips its duplicate text labels to 1px. The companion guard verifies the clipping contract, accessible button name, unique linked tooltip and keyboard focus; expanded labels are never exempt.
